purpose: A horizontal or vertical divider for a meaningful boundary between adjacent content.
behaviorProvider: Native div with optional separator semantics.

component: Default to decorative role none. With decorative=false expose role separator and aria-orientation matching orientation.
Expose orientation, variant and emphasis only as presentation attributes; no focus or resize behavior is added.
host: Use decorative dividers for visual grouping; use semantic separators only where a meaningful boundary should be announced.
Preserve structural meaning through headings and grouping rather than relying on a line alone.

Use layout group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: This is not a draggable splitter or keyboard-resizable control.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
